thread:
Priya: Heads up — Horizon Retail pulled in their CTO + CISO. They want Dedicated capacity SLA + SSO before signing. Main blockers: 1) SAML SSO cert exchange + allowlist 2) Throughput SLA (need ~5k rps sustained for POC) 3) Pricing alignment on reserved capacity. Can Eng/Infra confirm feasibility and ETA? cc @Elena @Connor
Connor: Re: throughput — Dedicated SKU can hit this with 8x A100s or 16x H100 baseline. Need EngInfra to confirm autoscale policy and network egress perf. Can we offer a temporary burst pool for the POC?
Maya: Egress from eu-west1 looks fine, but 5k rps sustained needs isolation. We can spin a reserved pool for the POC — ETA ~48h if infra approves capacity. Adding runbook note.
Raj: We have physical capacity in the EU region, but carving dedicated hardware needs procurement & legal signoff. SAML inbound requires static IP allowlist + SP metadata exchange. I can draft steps; need customer IdP metadata.
Elena: I'll set a 30m CTO bridge at 15:30 PT. Priya — can you confirm customer availability? Also finance wants a provisional pricing ask to review before the call.
LegalOps: Security questionnaire flagged DPA amendment and liability cap. If you drop the doc here we can prioritize review, but full redlines may take 24–48h.
Priya: Customer confirmed 15:30 PT for the bridge. Pricing ask: Horizon is requesting 20% off for a 12mo committed pool. Sales can accept contingent on SLA + SSO completion. @Maya please attach runbook; @Raj prepare SP metadata steps.
Connor: They also want low-latency streaming + function-calling during POC. Recommend pinning to model-r1-small-quantized for memory/latency tradeoff. Sample request config to test streaming:
```
{
  "model": "redwood/r1-small-quantized",
  "stream": true,
  "max_tokens": 1024
}
```
Maya: Runbook (internal): https://internal/runbooks/horizon-poc — will upload perf dashboards before the bridge. Ops aims to provision reserved pool today and run initial perf test.
Raj: SP metadata checklist: need entityID, ACS URL, cert (x509), NameID format. Send their metadata XML to infra-setup@redwood.com. Static IPs to allowlist: 34.72.11.90, 34.72.11.91.
Elena: Finance — @Marco can you provisionally approve up to 20% discount for a 12mo reserved pool pending exec signoff?
Marco: I can provisionally approve up to 15%. 20% needs Head of Sales approval. Also note any DPA changes that increase liability cap will affect discount authority.
Priya: Noted — pushing 20% in the negotiation, but will accept 15% if we need faster signoff. @LegalOps, questionnaire uploaded to /legal/horizon-2026.
Connor: Networking note — IdP handshake may require TLS client certs. @Raj can we support mTLS on the SAML endpoint?
Raj: Yes, mTLS supported. Need cert bundle + rotation plan from customer. I'll draft a checklist and a short how-to to exchange metadata.
Elena: Agenda for the bridge: 1) Confirm SSO flow and timeline 2) Confirm Dedicated pool capacity & ETA 3) Pricing & next steps. Invite sent.
LegalOps: Received questionnaire, will triage today and post initial redline comments to the doc by EOD.
Priya: Great — if infra + legal can confirm by EOD we can give customer a clear signoff path and likely get a signature within 48–72h.
Maya: Running first perf tests now against a temporary reserved pool. Will post results here in ~2h. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: Reserved pool job dp-88321 — status: provisioning (started 1738642400).
Connor: One last callout — for the POC keep tokenization and prefix cache warm for the demo to hit steady-state latency. I'll prepare a small script.
Priya: Thanks all. I'll lead the bridge and capture action items. If anyone gets blocked please ping me directly.
Maya: Perf tests done; 95th p99 token latency ~85ms on pinned config. Uploading graphs.
Raj: Drafted SP metadata how-to and rotation policy. Dropped doc in #shared-drive and emailed infra-setup.
LegalOps: Initial DPA amendment draft in /legal/horizon-2026/redlines.md — flagged two sections for commercial review.
Marco: Finance: if they push for 20% we should ask for a 15% up-front + 5% performance bonus tied to SLOs. Sending suggested term sheet.
Elena: Excellent. Closing loop after bridge.
DeployBot: Reserved pool job dp-88321 — status: ready (1738642820).
